name: The Singleton
summary: This EA implements the Singleton design pattern for MQL5 Expert Advisors, ensuring only one instance of the EA can run on a terminal at a time. It prevents duplicate instances from executing simultaneously, which could cause conflicting trades or resource conflicts. The core functionality is a protective utility mechanism rather than a trading strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了MQL5 Expert Advisor的单例设计模式，确保终端中同一时间只能运行一个EA实例。它防止重复实例同时执行，避免冲突交易或资源冲突。核心功能是保护性工具机制而非交易策略。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是实现单例模式的工具类EA。其核心概念是通过全局变量、文件锁或图表检查机制确保只有一个EA实例在运行。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，该EA仅监控和阻止重复实例。仓位管理不涉及，因为不存在开仓行为。资金管理方面无需考虑，该EA不处理任何资金相关逻辑。整体而言，这是一个架构级别的保护工具，用于防止多实例冲突导致的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements the Singleton design pattern rather than a trading strategy, ensuring only one EA instance runs per terminal. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable; the EA only monitors and blocks duplicate instances. Position sizing is not involved as there is no trade-opening behavior. Money management is irrelevant since the EA does not handle any capital-related logic. The mechanism typically uses global variables, file-based locks, or chart scanning to detect and prevent duplicate instances from running simultaneously, protecting against conflicting orders or resource contention.

pros: 防止多实例同时运行导致的交易冲突
架构层面提供保护，减少人为操作失误风险
实现简单有效，不增加交易逻辑复杂度
pros_en: Prevents trade conflicts caused by multiple EA instances running simultaneously
Provides architectural-level protection reducing risk of human operational errors
Simple and effective implementation without adding complexity to trading logic
cons: 不执行任何交易策略，仅作为辅助工具使用
可能阻止合法的多品种同策略部署场景
缺少详细的配置选项，灵活性有限
cons_en: Does not execute any trading strategy, serving only as an auxiliary utility
May prevent legitimate multi-symbol deployment of the same strategy
Lacks detailed configuration options, limiting flexibility
improvements: 增加白名单功能，允许特定品种或图表的多实例运行
添加日志记录功能，记录实例创建和阻止事件
improvements_en: Add a whitelist feature allowing multiple instances on specific symbols or charts
Add logging functionality to record instance creation and blocking events

risk_points: 阻止机制失效可能导致多实例冲突
缺乏对阻止事件的持久化记录
risk_points_en: Failure of the blocking mechanism could lead to multi-instance conflicts
Lack of persistent logging for blocked instance events
